description: 한국철도공사_KTX 노선별 역정보 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도공사. 한국철도공사KTX 노선별 역정보는 한국철도공사가 운영하는 주요 KTX 노선에 따라 각 역의 도로명 주소와 역명을 노선 순서대로 정리한 데이터입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도공사. Its tags are KTX 노선, 역 주소, 도로명주소, 공간 정보, 역 순번. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
